retainedV2SemanticProjection.mergeAlgorithm: Start from the exact parsed v2 object; remove exactly replacedSelectors; retain every inheritedTopLevelSelectors value by exact recursive type/value/order equality; overlay the named v3 sections. Any absent, extra, reordered array, changed scalar/type, or unlisted overlay rejects v3.

schemaLanguageV3.closedMap: A record contains exactly its variant required fields plus explicitly listed optional fields; every other field rejects the candidate at artifact time or faults a hostile runtime state/event before semantic use.
schemaLanguageV3.taggedUnion: The declared discriminator is required and exact; exactly one variant tag matches; unknown tags reject candidate/runtime input according to its boundary.
schemaLanguageV3.exactType: JSON boolean is not integer; uint64 is an integer in 0..18446744073709551615; strings/enums are exact NFC scalar values; null is admitted only by a nominal type whose enum explicitly contains null; no coercion, default, truthiness, widening or numeric conversion exists.
schemaLanguageV3.array: definite ordered array with declared bounds; uniqueness is exact recursive equality; no implicit sorting.

referencePathGrammar.resolution: exact match in allowedReferencePaths; prefix, alias, case fold, map traversal and unknown fields reject artifact

schemaLanguageV3.artifactFailure: Any ill-typed, inconsistent, unknown-field, unknown-op, unavailable-reference, over-bound, duplicate-ID/priority, selector-incompatible or invariant AST rejects the candidate before execution.
schemaLanguageV3.runtimeFailure: For an admitted artifact, runtime missing reference, wrong type, overflow, malformed state/event or invariant failure produces exact original state with only phase=FAULT; no precheck/action write commits.

transitionRuleSchemaV3.staticCompatibility: Every event reference in guard/actions must be non-null for every frameType selected by eventSelector. Process selectors cannot read frame-only fields. phaseIn/eventSelector pairs not selected by a preceding rule are owned by the exact fallback.
transitionRuleSchemaV3.matching: ascending priority; phase membership, then selector, then guard. A false guard continues. First true guard owns the event. Guard runtime failure faults atomically.

stateRecordV3.evaluation: Evaluate every invariant in listed order on valid input state before prechecks and again on the staged post-action state. A false assertion whose when is true, or any runtime evaluation failure, faults atomically. FAULT is absorbing and bypasses invariant evaluation.
